clips.title: The story
paras: In the Undercity's Trade Quarter, Gordon Wendham sells weapons and helps couriers from the surface find their way.

Gordon Wendham sells weapons to those who take up arms for the Forsaken. His stock ranges from daggers and hand axes to broadswords and maces. Fledgling fighters can find dependable iron here before they venture into the contested reaches of Lordaeron.

Travelers sent by flight masters and couriers are often directed to Gordon Wendham's stall. Some arrive from the bat handlers atop the ruins. His place in the Trade Quarter makes him easy to find when travelers need supplies or have dispatches to carry through the underground city.
